key.name: menu-blur
key.description: How strongly what is behind the control centre and its menus is blurred.

key.name: menu-tint
key.description: How much of the glass colour is mixed into the blurred backdrop.

key.name: menu-brightness
key.description: 1 leaves the backdrop as it is, below 1 darkens it, above 1 brightens it.

key.name: menu-saturation
key.description: 1 leaves the colours of the backdrop as they are, above 1 makes them richer.

key.name: spot-blur
key.description: How strongly what is behind Spotlight is blurred.

key.name: spot-tint
key.description: How much white is mixed into the blurred backdrop. Spotlight uses dark text, so keep it fairly high.

key.name: spot-brightness
key.description: 1 leaves the backdrop as it is, below 1 darkens it, above 1 brightens it.

key.name: spot-saturation
key.description: 1 leaves the colours of the backdrop as they are, above 1 makes them richer.

key.name: dock-glass
key.description: Draw Liquid Glass behind the dock. Dash to Dock, the Ubuntu Dock, Dash2Dock Animated and Glide Dock are recognised by their own actors; any other dock is used when it exposes a background actor.

key.name: dock-blur
key.description: How strongly what is behind the dock is blurred.

key.name: dock-tint
key.description: How much white is mixed into the blurred backdrop.

key.name: dock-brightness
key.description: 1 leaves the backdrop as it is, below 1 darkens it, above 1 brightens it.

key.name: dock-saturation
key.description: 1 leaves the colours of the backdrop as they are, above 1 makes them richer.

key.name: dock-corner
key.description: The radius of the dock's corners, in pixels.

key.name: corner-smoothing
key.description: 0 is a plain circular corner; towards 1 the corners become continuous curves, as on macOS.
